name: 29_Workflow catalogue
title: 27 smaller workflows
rows: Candidate self-registers > normalize login > verify identity channel > capture consent > create own profile > audit
Authorize owner > edit repeating profile sections > validate domains > version resume > recalculate completion > append activity
Create account > register organisation > store tokenized identifiers > request verification > verify outcome > map recruiters
Employer drafts requirement > add skills/questions > validate salary and positions > verify organisation > publish
Search published jobs > inspect questions > select own resume > answer required questions > insert unique application > append applied event
Shortlist visible candidate > schedule interview > record interview > issue offer > record acceptance and joining > append every status event
Consultant requests access > employer accepts/declines > recheck consultant openness > submit candidate shortlist > close on job closure
Recruiter selects own-company job > filter blocked candidates > create batch > lock wallet > debit once > recheck consent/block > enqueue delivery
Candidate selects party > create user/company block > invalidate visibility cache > exclude search/view/export/outreach > append denied-read evidence
Worker creates separate gig profile > declares service/rate/availability > requester posts gig > worker applies > requester accepts > validate nonoverlap > create handoff
Persist external handoff key > ingest idempotent provider event > reconcile assignment status > snapshot external earnings > requester rates completed gig
Lock licence > allocate available seat > register owned device > lock user > expire stale sessions > count active sessions > admit or deny > audit/revoke
Choose plan > create nonoverlapping period > create payment order > verify provider capture > append payment and credit > issue invoice > bound cumulative refunds
Authorize recruiter and candidate visibility > lock wallet > reuse idempotency key or append debit > append download event > issue short-lived object access
Update language/privacy/channel preference > match published job alert > check purpose consent > enqueue notification > recheck opt-out > record provider delivery
Create post or support ticket > moderate or assign > append reaction/referral events > resolve/reopen ticket > localize FAQ > record candidate activity
Version reference codes/translations > apply role grants > refresh conformed dimensions > load facts at declared grain > aggregate KPIs > record failures
Receive external or retention trigger > validate version/policy > reconcile or quarantine > unlink expired personal tokens > purge authorized data > append evidence

Create target-job journey > Bind candidate and account scope > Resolve job family and engagement > Evaluate the versioned eligibility rules > Record screening source event > Permit eligible candidate submission
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register
Assessment completion and its source event

Confirm application and assessment context > Issue a scoped assessment invitation > Record a tokenized provider attempt > Validate completion and result units > Link the attempt to this application > Publish the assessed milestone
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register

Authorize the assigned interviewer > Schedule the candidate interview > Record interview completion > Apply the job-specific evaluation rubric > Record selected or employer-rejected decision > Publish outcome to the hiring cohort
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register

Verify selection before offer creation > Approve terms, currency and expiry > Deliver the offer under valid consent > Authenticate the responding candidate > Record acceptance or candidate decline > Publish the first offer and response times
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register

Verify accepted offer and identity > Keep pending onboarding visible > Confirm the actual joining date > Validate job vacancy capacity > Publish the onboarded milestone > Reconcile onboarding KPI and pending ageing
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register
External handoff, callback, earnings and rating

Verify accepted assignment and time window > Send a uniquely keyed external handoff > Return signed provider state and source version > Keep failed handoff pending for retry > Reconcile externally completed earnings > Allow the owner to rate completed work
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register
Owned source contracts and quarantined records

Fingerprint the received file and contract > Validate account binding and required types > Translate source identifiers within account > Detect duplicate keys and conflicting payloads > Quarantine invalid or stale state updates > Reconcile applied, refused and pending counts
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register
Resolve the owning account and recipient > Recheck consent, blocking and expiry > Reserve an idempotent delivery key > Send or retain a bounded pending retry > Audit delivery or cancellation outcome
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register
Versioned smaller sets and reproducible analytics

Select mini or seed and its workflow set > Resolve the set grain, filters and source hashes > Generate scoped workflow example envelopes > Calculate counts, outcomes and business ratios > Review anomalies and publish the evidence
Mentor image / v6 business scenarios and gap register
